itemListElement.alternateName: StepFun StepAudio 3 — مجاني حتى 8 نوفمبر 2026 الساعة 18:59:59 بتوقيت بغداد
itemListElement.description: Covered StepAudio 3 services remain free through 2026-11-08 23:59:59 UTC+8, i.e. 2026-11-08 18:59:59 Baghdad time (UTC+3). New prices take effect at 2026-11-09 00:00 UTC+8, i.e. 2026-11-08 19:00 Baghdad time. Listed services include real-time voice chat, TTS, ASR, audio generation and music generation. Card and Iraq eligibility are not stated; no numeric free quota is given.

itemListElement.name: Cloady — Free Tier and Trial for App and Database Hosting, No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: Cloady — طبقة وتجربة مجانيتان لاستضافة التطبيقات وقواعد البيانات بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Cloady by NeptoLab hosts apps and databases. Its official page says “Free to start, no card needed” and offers a free tier and trial in selected regions. It labels AUS1 (Australia), EU1 (Germany), IND1 (India), JPN1 (Japan), UK1, USC1, USE1 and USW1 as Free trial; SIN1 (Singapore) is out of stock. The page does not separately identify free-tier regions or state an amount or duration; Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Daytona — $200 Free Compute for Instant Sandboxes
itemListElement.alternateName: Daytona — $200 حوسبة مجانية لصناديق الاختبار الفورية
itemListElement.description: Daytona’s pricing page lists $200 in free compute for Instant Sandboxes and says billing is calculated per second. It does not say the credit is granted on signup or state eligibility, expiry, or card terms; Iraq eligibility is also not stated.

itemListElement.name: Prized — $30 One-Time Sandbox Credit per Person (No Card)
itemListElement.alternateName: Prized — رصيد $30 لمرة واحدة لكل شخص لصناديق الاختبار (بلا بطاقة)
itemListElement.description: Prized’s official docs say the $30 credit is once per person and requires no card; they further qualify access as once per inbox if signup passes Prized’s checks. On free credit alone: up to 10 concurrent sandboxes (20 vCPU and 40 GB total), up to 2 vCPU/4 GB per sandbox, 60 minutes total running time per sandbox, and 100 GB disk across the workspace; no GPUs. After the credit, top-ups start at $10 or a plan can be selected.

itemListElement.name: KRAFTON Raon-1 mini Preview — Limited-Time Free API (30B-A4B Open Weights)
itemListElement.alternateName: KRAFTON Raon-1 mini preview — API مجاني لفترة محدودة (30B-A4B مفتوح الأوزان)
itemListElement.description: KRAFTON’s Raon-1 mini preview is a 30B-A4B open-weight model under Apache 2.0. The official page says API access is currently free for a limited time, with no end date announced; per-user token and request limits may apply, and future charges/policies will be announced separately. Access starts through the page’s application/sign-up flow; age, card and Iraq eligibility are not stated as offer requirements there.

itemListElement.name: Tensorlake — $0 Forever Free Tier for One Sandbox, No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: Tensorlake — طبقة مجانية $0 دائمًا لصندوق اختبار واحد بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Tensorlake’s Firecracker microVM Free plan is “$0 forever”: one sandbox at a time with 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 10 GB disk, sessions up to two hours, and unmetered sessions; the FAQ says no credit card is required. The paid Usage Credits pack starts at $5 and is not required for Free. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Fly.io Sprites — $30 Trial Credit for Eligible New Organizations
itemListElement.alternateName: Fly.io Sprites — $30 رصيد تجريبي للمنظمات الجديدة المؤهلة
itemListElement.description: Sprites includes $30 in trial credits for eligible new organizations; each user can grant one credit and each organization can receive at most one. Billing is based on actual CPU, memory and storage consumption. Eligibility must be confirmed at signup; the page does not state the credit duration or card policy. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Vercel Sandbox — Free Hobby Allowance, Creation Pauses for 30 Days at Limit
itemListElement.alternateName: Vercel Sandbox — حصة Hobby مجانية مع إيقاف الإنشاء 30 يومًا عند تجاوز الحد
itemListElement.description: Hobby ($0) includes monthly 5 Active CPU hours, 420 GB-hours memory, 5,000 sandbox creations and 20 GB transfer; up to 10 concurrent sandboxes and 45-minute sessions. Vercel says Sandbox is free for Hobby users with no overage billing; after quota is exceeded, creation pauses until 30 days have passed since first use. Hobby is for personal, non-commercial use only. Card and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: Freestyle — Monthly Free VM Allowances with No Usage Billing
itemListElement.alternateName: Freestyle — حصص شهرية مجانية لآلات VMs بلا فوترة استخدام
itemListElement.description: The $0 Free plan includes monthly 200 vCPU-hours, 400 GiB-hours memory, 60,000 GiB-hours storage and 50 GB transfer; up to 10 concurrent VMs, with up to 4 vCPU, 8 GiB and 32 GB disk per VM. Freestyle calls the allowances hard limits: usage does not continue into paid overage, and affected VMs pause when a quota is exhausted until reset. Adding a card to a Free account charges $1 for verification and is fully refunded; the page does not explicitly state whether a card is required. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Z.ai — Free Flash Models in API Pricing ($0 Input and Output)
itemListElement.alternateName: Z.ai — نماذج Flash مجانية بتسعير API ($0 للإدخال والإخراج)
itemListElement.description: The official pricing table lists three models as Free for input, cached input and output: GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash (text), and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision). The page does not state a token limit or expiry and does not specify account/key, card or country eligibility; Iraq is not mentioned officially.

itemListElement.name: AMD Token Lab — 10 Free Token Lab Points, Valid 30 Days
itemListElement.alternateName: AMD Token Lab — 10 نقاط Token Lab مجانية صالحة 30 يومًا
itemListElement.description: AMD says eligible AI Developer Program members receive 10 Token Lab points upon activation, valid for 30 days, with no credit request. This is distinct from Developer Cloud credits; card and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: GonkaRouter — 1M Free Tokens to Start, No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: GonkaRouter — مليون توكن مجاني للبدء بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: GonkaRouter offers 1M free tokens to start and says no card is required. Its docs describe OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs and list GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiniMax M2.7. Token expiry and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: Vectoree — $5 After CLI Login and Project Link
itemListElement.alternateName: Vectoree — رصيد $5 بعد تسجيل الدخول وربط المشروع
itemListElement.description: Vectoree grants $5 after CLI login and project linking, with no monthly fee; later use is pay-as-you-go. Credit expiry, card requirement and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: NovAI — $2 for 14 Days Plus Five Free Models
itemListElement.alternateName: NovAI — $2 لمدة 14 يومًا وخمسة نماذج مجانية
itemListElement.description: New accounts receive $2 valid for 14 days, plus five free models with up to 10 calls/day and 5 requests/minute before top-up. The official registration page says no card is required; Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: AI Horde — Free Anonymous Image and Text Generation
itemListElement.alternateName: AI Horde — توليد صور ونص مجانًا دون تسجيل
itemListElement.description: AI Horde offers free anonymous image and text generation without signup or a card. Anonymous requests have lower priority and availability depends on volunteer workers; Iraq availability is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Free Plan — 300 Daily Refresh Credits in 2.0 Lite
itemListElement.alternateName: الخطة المجانية — 300 رصيد يومي لوضع 2.0 Lite
itemListElement.description: Free users can claim 300 daily refresh credits, capped at 1,500/month. The refresh credits work only in Manus 2.0 Lite and reset daily without rollover. Card and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: Searlo — 3,000 One-Time Credits, Valid One Year
itemListElement.alternateName: Searlo — 3,000 رصيدًا لمرة واحدة صالحًا سنة
itemListElement.description: New users receive 3,000 credits once at signup, valid for one year, with no card or subscription. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Retell AI — $10 Trial Credit Once per Email
itemListElement.alternateName: Retell AI — رصيد تجريبي $10 مرة لكل بريد
itemListElement.description: New accounts receive $10 in trial credit once per email; voice-agent rates are $0.07–$0.31/min. Managed standard numbers are US/Canada only at $2/month, toll-free $5/month. Credit expiry, card and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: MegaNova AI — Selected Free Tier-1 Models, No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: MegaNova AI — نماذج Tier 1 مجانية مختارة بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Tier 1 has selected free models: Manta Mini is limited to 50 requests/day, published free-model quotas total 550/day, and the limit is 60 requests/minute. No card is required; duration and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: ngram — 1,000 Monthly Credits with Work Email
itemListElement.alternateName: ngram — 1,000 رصيد شهريًا ببريد العمل
itemListElement.description: Free includes 1,000 monthly credits with a work email or 500 with a personal email, plus one premium video/month up to 60 seconds at 720p. No MP4 download or commercial use; no card. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Articul8 Bivia — 1B Free Tokens for First 10,000 Early Adopters
itemListElement.alternateName: Articul8 Bivia — مليار توكن مجاني لأول 10,000 مستخدم مبكر
itemListElement.description: Articul8 advertises 1B free tokens for the first 10,000 early adopters, with no subscription. The source does not specify input tokens, remaining slots, expiry, card policy or Iraq eligibility.

itemListElement.name: Lindy — $50 Free Credits for 7 Days; Check Billing Path
itemListElement.alternateName: Lindy — $50 رصيدًا مجانيًا لمدة 7 أيام؛ تحقق من الفوترة
itemListElement.description: Lindy advertises $50 in credits valid for 7 days and says no card is required. Its FAQ says direct signups are billed immediately while Slack joining grants a free week; check the signup path. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: deAPI — $5 Free Signup Credit, No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: deAPI — رصيد تسجيل $5 بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: New accounts receive $5 at signup with no card; Basic limits are typically 1–10 requests/minute by endpoint. Official sources reviewed do not state expiry or temporary-email restrictions; Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: Dahl Inference — First 100M Tokens Free
itemListElement.alternateName: Dahl Inference — أول 100 مليون توكن مجانًا
itemListElement.description: Dahl advertises the first 100M tokens free; they expire after 7 consecutive days without a request, and any request resets the timer. Public pages do not establish signup method; card and Iraq eligibility are not stated.

itemListElement.name: VModel — $10 Signup Credit for Image, Video and Text
itemListElement.alternateName: VModel — رصيد تسجيل $10 للصور والفيديو والنص
itemListElement.description: New users receive $10 in API credit without a card, for image, video and text models. Free credit may expire, but no date is stated; purchased-credit expiry terms are separate. Iraq eligibility is not stated.

itemListElement.name: AI21 Labs — Free Trial ($10 Credit for 7 Days, No Card)
itemListElement.alternateName: AI21 Labs — تجربة مجانية ($10 رصيد لـ7 أيام، بلا بطاقة)
itemListElement.description: Free trial on AI21 Labs Jamba models: the official pricing page lists $10 in credits for 7 days and explicitly says no credit card is needed. The source does not limit the offer to new accounts; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: SiliconFlow — $1 in Free Credits
itemListElement.alternateName: SiliconFlow — $1 رصيد مجاني
itemListElement.description: The official pricing FAQ says users can start with $1 in free credits. It does not explicitly tie the credit to signup or new accounts, and it does not state whether a payment card is required; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Vercel AI Gateway — Monthly Free Credit (Amount Not Officially Stated)
itemListElement.alternateName: Vercel AI Gateway — رصيد مجاني شهري (المبلغ غير محدد رسميًا)
itemListElement.description: Vercel provides teams with a free AI Gateway tier that includes a monthly free credit, starting with the first request. Vercel’s docs do not state a $5 amount. The free tier covers a subset of models at lower rate limits; purchasing paid credits ends the monthly free credit. Card requirements and Iraq eligibility are not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: E2B — $100 One-Time Usage Credit (Free Hobby Plan, AI Agent Sandboxes)
itemListElement.alternateName: E2B — $100 رصيد استخدام لمرة واحدة (خطة Hobby المجانية، sandbox لوكلاء AI)
itemListElement.description: E2B’s free Hobby plan includes a one-time $100 usage credit. The official pricing page notes additional usage costs based on consumption and explicitly says no credit card is required. Credit expiry and Iraq eligibility are not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Sail Research — $5 Monthly Credit (Open-Model Inference + Linux VMs)
itemListElement.alternateName: Sail Research — $5 رصيد شهري (استدلال نماذج مفتوحة + VMs لينكس)
itemListElement.description: A $5 monthly credit for inference via API or Sailboxes. The official pricing page explicitly requires attaching a payment method to receive the monthly credit; it does not state an end date or rollover of unused credit. Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Napkin AI — Free Plan (500 AI Credits per Week)
itemListElement.alternateName: Napkin AI — خطة مجانية (500 رصيد AI أسبوعيًا)
itemListElement.description: Napkin AI’s $0 Free plan provides 500 AI credits per week. It includes visual editing, file import, and PNG/PDF export, with Napkin branding on visuals; PPT/SVG export and branding removal are in paid plans. The page does not specify a card requirement; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints — 7 Free Models to Try in the Catalog (No Signup to Test)
itemListElement.alternateName: OVHcloud AI Endpoints — 7 نماذج مجانية للاختبار في الكتالوج (بلا تسجيل للتجربة)
itemListElement.description: The official catalog lists seven models tagged Free and says users can compare and test open models without signing up. This refers to trying the catalog; the API docs say integrations require a personalized access key. The sources do not establish a card requirement; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Pollinations.ai — Free Classic API for Images and Text (No Signup or API Key)
itemListElement.alternateName: Pollinations.ai — Classic API مجانية للصور والنص (بلا تسجيل أو مفتاح)
itemListElement.description: Pollinations’ official docs describe the Classic API as free, no-signup and rate-limited for existing apps: image requests must be at least 45 seconds apart and text requests at least 30 seconds apart per IP. Exceeding limits may return 402. The source does not state card requirements; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Apify — Free Plan ($5 Monthly Usage, No Card)
itemListElement.alternateName: Apify — خطة مجانية ($5 استخدام شهري، بلا بطاقة)
itemListElement.description: Apify’s $0 Free plan includes $5 of monthly platform usage, and the pricing page explicitly says no credit card is required. Unused credit does not roll over and expires at the end of the billing cycle; once depleted, free-plan access is blocked until the next cycle. Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Bright Data Web Unlocker — Free Tier (5,000 Requests/Month)
itemListElement.alternateName: Bright Data Web Unlocker — باقة مجانية (5,000 طلب/شهر)
itemListElement.description: The official Web Unlocker page offers a free tier with 5,000 requests per month specifically for Web Unlocker. It does not state whether the allowance renews monthly or whether a card is not required; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Parallel Decisions Fast — Free via Vercel AI Gateway Until 2026-11-23
itemListElement.alternateName: Parallel Decisions Fast — مجاني عبر Vercel AI Gateway حتى 23-11-2026
itemListElement.description: Parallel Decisions Fast is free through Vercel AI Gateway until November 23, 2026, with no separate Parallel account required. The price after that date and card requirements are not stated officially; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Claude API — Small Free Trial Credits for New Users (to Test the API)
itemListElement.alternateName: Claude API — رصيد تجريبي مجاني صغير للمستخدمين الجدد (لاختبار API)
itemListElement.description: Official Claude Platform docs say new users receive a small amount of free credits to test the API. The source does not publish a numeric amount, card requirement or expiry date; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Nanonets — $50 Free Credit on Signup (Document Data Extraction, No Card)
itemListElement.alternateName: Nanonets — $50 رصيد مجاني عند التسجيل (استخراج بيانات من المستندات، بلا بطاقة)
itemListElement.description: Nanonets accounts start with $50 in free credits, and its pricing page explicitly says no credit card is required. Credits are shared across the team and never expire; after they run out, the page lists a $100/month plan for 100 credits. Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Datalab — Free Plan: $20/Month (Work Email) or $10/Month (Personal Email), No Card
itemListElement.alternateName: Datalab — خطة مجانية: $20/شهر (بريد عمل) أو $10/شهر (بريد شخصي)، بلا بطاقة
itemListElement.description: Datalab’s Free plan provides a monthly usage allowance of $20 with a work email or $10 with a personal email across the hosted API; it resets each cycle and does not roll over. The pricing page says no card is needed to use the allowance, but a card is required to continue after it runs out. Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.

itemListElement.name: Voicegain — $50 Free Credit on Signup (Speech-to-Text, No Card)
itemListElement.alternateName: Voicegain — $50 رصيد مجاني عند التسجيل (تحويل كلام إلى نص، بلا بطاقة)
itemListElement.description: Voicegain provides every account with $50 in platform credit on signup, and the official page explicitly says no demo call or credit card is required. The page does not state the credit expiry; Iraq eligibility is not stated officially.
